note: P4327 (Pro 28:17) — one burdened with the blood of another is a fugitive until death; let none help him.

dims.v: haunted guilt — the murderer driven a fugitive by the blood he shed
the being burdened/crushed with the blood of another — the guilt of murder that makes a man a restless fugitive until death, a conscience that will not let him rest
(the blood of the victim that haunts him)
the bloodguilt that drives a man in ceaseless flight

ashaq (burdened/oppressed with) — 'if one is BURDENED with the blood of another, he will be a fugitive until death'; the guilt of shed blood haunts the murderer, driving him restless to the grave. Bloodguilt is a burden no man carries in peace (cf Gen 4:12-14).
